title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return the zigzag level order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from left to right, then right to left for the next level and alternate between). Return levels from top to bottom, reversing the value order on every other level, starting left to right.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7]
Output: [[3],[20,9],[15,7]]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: root = [1]
Output: [[1]]
```

### Example 3

```text
Input: root = []
Output: []
```

## Constraints

- The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 2000].
- -100 <= Node.val <= 100
